title: checklist
description: Items the person ticks off, optionally grouped with progress; a tick is a request the agent confirms.

label.description: What to do or get: Tomatoes, Metformin 500 mg, Renew the passport.

detail.description: One line under the label: an amount, a time, a note. “2 lb”, “8 AM with breakfast”, “$64.20”.

checked.description: Ticked. Only the agent’s update makes it final.

due.description: When it is due (a date, or a time). The client adds “Due Monday” or “Was due Tuesday” to the detail line and, while unticked, a trailing tag: “Mon” (neutral) or “3 days late” (warning), kept current.

assignee.description: Who it is for. Their first name ends the detail line (“· Maya”); a shared list shows their initials.

evidence.description: How a ticked item is known to be done, as a caption under the row: “Logged in Apple Health 08:04”, or a claim (“Said by Maya · family chat”), which is never shown as verified.

group.description: The group (aisle, person, room) it belongs to.

actions.description: Extra row actions (Snooze, Move to Tomorrow), sent with {item: <item id>}.

items.description: The items in the order to show them: late first for tasks, store order for shopping. Ticked items stay where they are.

title.description: Aisle, person or room: Produce, Maya, Kitchen.

groups.description: Group headings in order, each with its own progress.

progress.description: How the header shows progress. bar: “4 of 9” and a bar; count: “2 of 4”; open: “3 open” (what’s left); none.
